difficulty_rationale: Source priority matters only on equal timestamps and only per field, so record-level newest-wins logic fails.
Tombstones clear whole-record state and later events may recreate it, which forces a cutoff-aware merge.
Scalar fields can be explicitly cleared with null while absent fields are no-ops.
Tags use union-dedupe-sort semantics instead of newest-list-wins, so a common shortcut is wrong.
Canonical id normalization changes grouping and final output order at the same time.
Exact JSON formatting and key order are strict, so semantically correct but differently formatted output still loses lines.
One record is fully deleted and must disappear entirely, which catches implementations that emit empty shells.
Updated_at is derived from the events that define the surviving state, not simply from the last event for the id.
